podcast.title: Nyquist-Shannon Sampling Theorem Contribution (1928)
podcast.body: Harry Nyquist, an electronic engineer, introduced the foundational concept of the sampling theorem in 1928. This idea was presented in a paper published by what is referred to as "el suelo de americanos americanos" (likely a journal like the Bell System Technical Journal). His work posited that to accurately reconstruct a frequency, it must be sampled at a rate of at least twice its frequency. "fue propósita en 1928 en un papel pívidolo publicado por el suelo de americanos americanos, el ingeniero electrónico, Harry Nyquist."
